description: This file defines a mock class COMLinkMock, used for unit testing, which mocks the ICOMLink interface from the WPEFramework plugin host. It includes mock method declarations for registering and unregistering notifications, obtaining remote connections, and instantiating objects.

classes.name: COMLinkMock
classes.description: A mock class for the ICOMLink interface used in testing, providing mock implementations for interface methods.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks the method to register a remote connection notification.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks the method to unregister a remote connection notification.

methods.name: RemoteConnection
methods.description: Mocks the method to get a remote connection by its ID.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Mocks the method to create an instance of a remote object.
